outcome: Sonographic findings (normal sonographic findings in threatened abortion, uterine fibroids, placenta Previa, incomplete abortion, molar pregnancy, inevitable abortion, vasa Previa)
cohort: The study cohort consists of pregnant women presenting with per-vaginal bleeding who were referred for obstetric ultrasound scans at health facilities.
finding: Various sonographic findings, including normal sonography in threatened abortion, uterine fibroids, placenta previa, incomplete abortion, molar pregnancy, inevitable abortion, and vasa previa, were observed among pregnant women presenting with vaginal bleeding.
mod_finding: A history of caesarian section was reported by some respondents alongside per-vaginal bleeding.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, particularly in the first trimester when vaginal bleeding is common.
gest_age: The study includes pregnant women, with vaginal bleeding being commonly observed in the first trimester.
